\[
F_0 = H_{SF}(y),\quad F_{DF} = H_{DF}(F_0),\quad \hat{x} = \text{PixelShuffle}_2\big(H_{REC}(F_{DF} + F_0)\big)
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(y\): The small image
- \(H_{SF}, H_{DF}, H_{REC}\): Shallow features, deep features and reconstruction
- \(\hat{x}\): The enlarged image

y is the small image. A convolution H_SF gives shallow features. Four residual Swin Transformer groups H_DF give deep features, with attention inside windows of 8 x 8 pixels. The windows shift by 4 pixels in every second block. A last convolution H_REC gives 12 channels, and the pixel shuffle turns them into a picture two times larger.
